name: social-media-marketing
description: Organic social-media strategy and platform-native content for brands, products, services, creators, campaigns, launches, and channels. Covers audience and positioning, content pillars, 30/60/90-day plans, calendars, hooks, captions, scripts, titles and thumbnails, channel audits, competitor and content-gap analysis, repurposing, and monetization. Built around a claim-safety gate that separates source status from claim status and refuses to let ingredient evidence, animal research, or a disclaimer carry a headline the evidence does not support.
author: Dina Farhat
